That means switching to `.env.example` is safe. Let me make the 3 replacements.

The `.env.dev`/`.env.test0` history hits are real rotated secrets and belong to #14 (merge removes tracked `.env.dev`) + #16 (history purge), so I won't allowlist those. Vendor FP gone — only the 3 real `.env` history secrets remain (rotated dev creds → #16 history purge + #14 merge). Tasks #2 and #4 are done. Let me review the full set of uncommitted changes on the branch.

All changes are focused and clean. Here's where #12 stands.

## What I fixed (the automation/infra core)

**`bin/security-scan.sh`:**
1. **The exit-code bug (the headline item)** — `run_check` wrapped the scanner in `if "$@"; then…fi`, which returns 0 when the scanner *fails*, so `$?` read 0 and masked the failure. Rewrote to `local ec=0; "$@" || ec=$?`. Proven: continue-on-error now reports real codes (`Semgrep (7)`, `Composer (1)`, …) instead of `0`.
2. **Composer made runnable** — it used to hard-`exit 127` (killing the whole run) with no local composer/container. Added a `composer:2` Docker-image fallback.
3. **Trivy stall fixed** — one-time checks-bundle bootstrap + `--skip-check-update` (no more registry stall; ~2s offline runs), plus `--skip-dirs vendor/node_modules` so it only gates *our* Dockerfiles.
4. **Semgrep was completely broken** — `p/laravel` intermittently 404s and aborted the whole scan (exit 7, *zero* rules ran). Dropped it, added `p/security-audit`, added download-retry. **Semgrep now PASSES** (1 benign FP in Laravel's stock `server.php`).

**Workflow + config:** mirrored the Trivy/Semgrep changes in `security-scan.yml`; fixed item #3 — the `cp .env.dev .env` steps (×3) → `cp .env.example .env` (`.env.dev` is gone on `main`); brought the secret-free `.env.example` onto the branch; added a `vendor/`+`node_modules/` allowlist to `.gitleaks.toml` (kills the symfony FP).

## What the gate now surfaces (real findings)

| Scanner | Status | Detail |
|---|---|---|
| Semgrep | ✅ PASS | fixed |
| Trivy | ❌ 6 | our `app1/Dockerfile*`: non-root `USER`, `--no-install-recommends`, update+install |
| Composer | ❌ 15 / 10 pkgs | incl. **knp-snappy HIGH** (prod PDF dep), commonmark; rest dev-only (phpunit, psysh) |
| npm | ❌ 8 | 1 critical (form-data), most via `npm audit fix`; esbuild needs `--force` (breaking Vite) |
| Gitleaks | ❌ 3 | all **git history** `.env.dev`/`.env.test0` rotated creds |

The remaining failures are entangled with the **other two tickets on this shared branch**: the branch is 22 commits behind `main`, so `npm audit fix`/`composer update` here would fight `main`'s lockfiles at merge (that's #14's job), and the Gitleaks history hits need the history purge (#16). So "fully green" isn't really achievable on this stale branch alone.
